willingness: Observed financial-risk response; never map directly into CRRA
household_wealth: LIQ plus directly held STOCKS+BOND+NMMF; excludes housing, retirement balances, savings bonds and CDs
income: Wages plus nonnegative business income plus SSRETINC minus PENACCTWD plus nonnegative transfers; excludes capital gains and interest/dividends
expense_primary: 2025 reported nonhousing spending plus rent and debt service; compare published reconstruction and no-age medical imputation
stress: 40% equity/10% bond loss and six months without earned income; no new borrowing; three-month terminal outlay reserve
templates: 16 survey-weighted joint age/liquidity/willingness cell means, with MI/replicate uncertainty; no population prediction from template simulation
market_tests: Three assets only; WRDS and public source sensitivity; 2000 fitting and 5000 disjoint evaluation paths; 1/5/10-year frozen-state budget scenarios; 5bp executed-trade half-spread
primary_outputs: Outlay funding probability, unmet outlays, terminal liquid resources and reserve compliance; no interpretation as utility of debt principal or identified lifetime capacity
international: Maintain evidence levels; no common-country risk ranking from noncomparable measurements
